The log shows classic Bertrand price competition, not coordination. Aoki Supply and Foster Mart repeatedly undercut each other by small increments ($15 → $14 → $13 → $12.50 → $11.90 → $11.80 → $11.75 → $11.70 → $11.65 → $11.60 → $11.50), driving prices DOWN rather than jointly maintaining them high.
